title: AI / ML with Python
tagline: Become a job-ready ML engineer through projects: data foundations (NumPy, pandas, viz, SQL), classical machine learning with honest evaluation, deep learning (CNNs, RNNs, transformers), modern LLM/ge…
summary: Become a job-ready ML engineer through projects: data foundations (NumPy, pandas, viz, SQL), classical machine learning with honest evaluation, deep learning (CNNs, RNNs, transformers), modern LLM/generative-AI application work with your model provider's API, and the MLOps that gets models into production. Pairs naturally with the Python Core track (its prerequisite) and the AI-Native/LLM track.

capstone.title: End-to-end ML project
capstone.project: Take a real dataset from cleaning through a trained, evaluated, and DEPLOYED model: honest metrics, error analysis, an inference API, experiment tracking, and a README that explains the problem, approach, and limitations.

phases.title: Data Foundations
phases.goal: Wrangle, explore, and visualize data with NumPy, pandas, and SQL — the daily reality of ML work.

projects.title: NumPy Fundamentals
projects.description: Learn the ndarray: creation, dtypes, indexing, slicing, reshaping, and axis-based aggregation — the foundation of all numerical computing and ML in Python.

projects.title: Vectorization & Broadcasting
projects.description: Replace Python loops with vectorized NumPy operations and broadcasting, measuring the speedup and understanding why vectorized code is faster.

projects.title: pandas: Series & DataFrames
projects.description: Load, select, filter, and compute on real tabular data with pandas Series and DataFrames — indexing with loc/iloc, boolean filtering, and adding computed columns.

projects.title: Data Cleaning with pandas
projects.description: Clean a genuinely messy dataset: handle missing values, duplicates, wrong dtypes, inconsistent categories, and outliers — making explicit, defensible decisions.

projects.title: groupby & merge
projects.description: Aggregate data with split-apply-combine (groupby) and combine datasets with merge/join, the two operations behind almost every analytical question.

projects.title: Data Visualization
projects.description: Create clear, correct charts with matplotlib (and pandas plotting): line, bar, histogram, scatter, and box plots — each chosen to answer a specific question.

projects.title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
projects.description: Run a full EDA on a real dataset: summary statistics, distributions, correlations, and segment comparisons, surfacing real patterns and forming hypotheses before modeling.

projects.title: SQL for Data
projects.description: Query and aggregate data at the source with SQL (via sqlite3): SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, and subqueries — and learn when to aggregate in SQL vs pandas.

phases.title: Machine Learning Foundations
phases.goal: Train, evaluate, and reason about classical models honestly — no leakage, the right metric, real error analysis.

projects.title: Linear Regression
projects.description: Train your first supervised model: predict a continuous value with scikit-learn LinearRegression, with a proper train/test split and an appropriate regression metric.

projects.title: Classification with Logistic Regression
projects.description: Predict a category (not a number) with logistic regression, and evaluate it honestly with accuracy, precision, recall, and a confusion matrix — learning why accuracy alone misleads.

projects.title: Cross-Validation
projects.description: Replace a single train/test split with k-fold cross-validation for a more reliable performance estimate, and learn how to read the variance across folds.

projects.title: Overfitting & Regularization
projects.description: Deliberately produce overfit and underfit models, diagnose them with train-vs-validation curves, and fix overfitting with regularization — the central skill of ML.

projects.title: Feature Engineering & Pipelines
projects.description: Engineer features and wrap preprocessing + model in an sklearn Pipeline/ColumnTransformer so preprocessing is fit on training data only — preventing the most common cause of leakage.

projects.title: Model Evaluation & Error Analysis
projects.description: Go beyond aggregate metrics: build a confusion matrix, inspect concrete misclassified examples, and form grounded hypotheses about why the model fails and how to improve it.

projects.title: Decision Trees & Random Forests
projects.description: Train interpretable decision trees and powerful random forests, learning how trees split, why a single tree overfits, and how ensembling fixes it — plus feature importance.

projects.title: Gradient Boosting with XGBoost
projects.description: Train a gradient-boosted tree model (XGBoost/LightGBM or sklearn HistGradientBoosting), learning how boosting differs from bagging and how to use early stopping to control overfitting.

projects.title: Unsupervised Learning: Clustering & PCA
projects.description: Find structure in unlabeled data with k-means clustering and reduce dimensionality with PCA, learning how to choose k and what principal components represent.

phases.title: Advanced ML & Model Tuning
phases.goal: Get more from models: tuning, imbalanced data, ensembles, recommenders, and time series.

projects.title: Hyperparameter Tuning
projects.description: Tune model hyperparameters systematically with GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV, cross-validating inside the search to avoid leakage and overfitting to the validation set.

projects.title: Imbalanced Data
projects.description: Handle datasets where one class is rare (fraud, disease) using class weights, resampling (SMOTE/undersampling), and the right metrics (PR-AUC, recall) instead of accuracy.

projects.title: Feature Selection
projects.description: Reduce features to the ones that matter using filter (variance, univariate), wrapper (RFE), and embedded (L1/importance) methods, improving generalization and interpretability.

projects.title: Ensemble Methods: Voting & Stacking
projects.description: Combine diverse models with VotingClassifier and StackingClassifier to beat any single model, learning why model diversity is the key to ensemble gains.

projects.title: Recommender Systems
projects.description: Build content-based and collaborative-filtering recommenders, learning user-item matrices, similarity, and matrix factorization — and how to evaluate ranking quality.

projects.title: Time Series Forecasting
projects.description: Forecast temporal data: handle datetime indexing, resampling, lag/rolling features, and the special train/test split time series requires — never shuffle the future into the past.

projects.title: Text Features with TF-IDF
projects.description: Turn raw text into numerical features with bag-of-words and TF-IDF, then train a text classifier — the classical NLP pipeline that's still a strong baseline.

phases.title: Deep Learning
phases.goal: Build and train neural networks with PyTorch — from a hand-written training loop to CNNs, RNNs, and transformers.

projects.title: PyTorch Tensors & Autograd
projects.description: Learn PyTorch tensors (NumPy-like, GPU-capable) and automatic differentiation (autograd) — the engine that computes gradients for neural network training.

projects.title: Neural Network Training Loop
projects.description: Build and train a small neural network in PyTorch from scratch — define nn.Module, write the forward/loss/backward/step loop yourself, and track loss and a held-out metric.

projects.title: Improving Training: Regularization & Optimizers
projects.description: Combat overfitting and speed up convergence in neural nets with dropout, batch normalization, weight decay, learning-rate scheduling, and mini-batching via DataLoader.

projects.title: CNNs for Image Classification
projects.description: Build a convolutional neural network to classify images (MNIST/FashionMNIST), learning convolutions, pooling, and why CNNs beat dense nets on images.

projects.title: Transfer Learning
projects.description: Fine-tune a pretrained CNN (e.g. ResNet) on a new image task, learning to freeze/unfreeze layers and why transfer learning beats training from scratch with limited data.

projects.title: RNNs & LSTMs for Sequences
projects.description: Model sequential data with recurrent networks (RNN/LSTM) — predict the next value or classify a sequence — and learn why LSTMs handle long-range dependencies better than vanilla RNNs.

projects.title: Attention & Transformers
projects.description: Understand self-attention and build a small transformer encoder, learning why attention replaced recurrence and powers modern AI (BERT, frontier and open-weights models).

projects.title: Embeddings & Semantic Similarity
projects.description: Represent text as dense vectors with a sentence-embedding model and measure semantic similarity with cosine distance — the foundation of search, clustering, and RAG.

projects.title: NLP with Pretrained Transformers
projects.description: Use the transformers library to run and fine-tune a pretrained language model (e.g. DistilBERT) for text classification — applying transfer learning to NLP.

phases.title: LLMs & Generative AI
phases.goal: Build real applications on large language models with your model provider's API: prompting, structured output, RAG, evaluation, and agents.

projects.title: LLM API Basics
projects.description: Make your first calls to the model with your model provider's SDK: messages, system prompts, multi-turn conversations, model/token parameters, and reading the response and usage.

projects.title: Prompt Engineering Patterns
projects.description: Apply reliable prompting techniques with the model — clear instructions, few-shot examples, role/system prompts, chain-of-thought, and XML-tag structuring — and measure their effect.

projects.title: Structured Output Extraction
projects.description: Get guaranteed schema-valid JSON from the model using structured outputs (output_config.format / messages.parse) so LLM responses can flow directly into your code.

projects.title: Tool Use & Function Calling
projects.description: Let the model call your Python functions: define tools, run the agentic loop (tool_use -> execute -> tool_result), and let the model decide when to use them.

projects.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
projects.description: Ground the model's answers in your own documents: embed a knowledge base, retrieve the most relevant chunks for a question, and pass them as context so the model answers from your data.

projects.title: Evaluating LLM Outputs
projects.description: Measure LLM quality systematically: build a test set, score with exact/structured checks and an LLM-as-judge, and track quality across prompt or model changes instead of guessing.

projects.title: Streaming, Caching & Cost
projects.description: Make LLM apps responsive and affordable: stream responses token-by-token, use prompt caching for repeated context, count tokens, and choose models by cost/quality.

projects.title: Build an LLM Agent
projects.description: Combine tool use, the agentic loop, and a system prompt into a small autonomous agent that plans, calls multiple tools across turns, and produces a final answer — with guardrails.

phases.title: MLOps & Production
phases.goal: Track, serve, monitor, and ship models — turn notebooks into reliable production systems.

projects.title: Experiment Tracking with MLflow
projects.description: Track ML experiments with MLflow: log parameters, metrics, and artifacts; compare runs; and make results reproducible instead of lost in notebooks.

projects.title: Model Serialization
projects.description: Save and load trained models safely with joblib/pickle and the full preprocessing pipeline, learning versioning, the security risk of pickle, and saving everything needed for inference.

projects.title: Model Serving with FastAPI
projects.description: Wrap a trained model behind a FastAPI prediction endpoint: validate input, load the model once at startup, return predictions, and handle bad input gracefully.

projects.title: Data & Model Versioning with DVC
projects.description: Version large datasets and model artifacts with DVC alongside git, so an experiment ties code + data + model together and is fully reproducible.

projects.title: Model Monitoring & Drift Detection
projects.description: Detect when a deployed model degrades: log predictions, monitor input/prediction distributions, and flag data drift so you know when to retrain.

projects.title: Containerizing ML with Docker
projects.description: Package a model-serving app in Docker so it runs identically anywhere: write a Dockerfile, pin dependencies, keep the image small, and run the container.

projects.title: CI for Machine Learning
projects.description: Set up continuous integration for an ML project with GitHub Actions: run tests, lint, and a small model-quality check on every push so regressions are caught automatically.

projects.title: Batch vs Online Inference
projects.description: Implement both serving patterns — real-time online inference and offline batch scoring — and learn when each fits based on latency, throughput, and cost.
